items.title: GSoC Week 15: Owning the Recursion
items.content_text: This is the last week of coding, and it landed on the piece of work that everything else this summer had been quietly building toward: turning manualintegrate's tangle of self-recursive rules into a single IntegrationSolver that owns the recursion on their behalf.
